label: For "Soft Sensor for Hard-to-Measure Quantities": Estimate quantities such as composition, viscosity or moisture that are measured rarely in a lab from fast process signals, so control and quality decisions can be made in real time. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Using sample time as process time.
